original_value: In inconsistent and indeterminate settings, as a usual tool, the neutrosophic cubic set (NCS) containing single-valued neutrosophic numbers and interval neutrosophic numbers can be applied in decision-making to present its partial indeterminate and partial determinate information. However, a few researchers have studied neutrosophic cubic decision-making problems, where the similarity measure of NCSs is one of the useful measure methods. For this work, we propose the Dice, cotangent, and Jaccard measures between NCSs, and indicate their properties. Then, under an NCS environment, the similarity measures-based decision-making method of multiple attributes is developed. In the decision-making process, all the alternatives are ranked by the similarity measure of each alternative and the ideal solution to obtain the best one. Finally, two practical examples are applied to indicate the feasibility and effectiveness of the developed method.

result.paraphrase: In inconsistent and indeterminate settings, neutrosophic cubic sets (NCSs), which include single-valued neutrosophic numbers and interval neutrosophic numbers, are commonly used in decision-making to represent partial indeterminacy and partial determinacy. However, only a limited number of researchers have investigated neutrosophic cubic decision-making problems, among which the similarity measure of NCSs is one useful approach. In this study, we introduce Dice, cotangent, and Jaccard measures for NCSs and present their properties. We then develop a similarity-measure-based multi-attribute decision-making method under an NCS environment. In the decision process, each alternative is ranked according to its similarity to the ideal solution in order to identify the best one. Finally, two practical examples are used to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.
